Browser
Bookmark Bar
nodes.title: Browser Bookmark Management
nodes.info: Keeping every club laptop's set of saved links consistent, curated, and organised into folders, rather than letting each browser accumulate its own random growing list of one-off links.

nodes.label:
Class Bookmark
Folder
nodes.title: Class Bookmark Folder
nodes.info: A single shared folder, identical across every laptop in the fleet, holding the links every student needs: the coding platform, the club glossary, and the current unit's project documentation.

nodes.label:
Coding Platform
Link
nodes.title: Coding Platform Link
nodes.info: A link every student needs belongs in the shared class folder, so a mentor's one update reaches every laptop.

nodes.label:
Club Glossary
Link
nodes.title: Club Glossary Link
nodes.info: Reference material used by the whole club is shared through the class folder rather than duplicated in each student's personal space.

nodes.label:
Student Bookmark
Folder
nodes.title: Student Bookmark Folder
nodes.info: A personal folder inside a student's own bookmark bar, separate from the shared class folder, for links specific to that student's own in-progress project.

nodes.label:
My In-Progress
Project
nodes.title: My In-Progress Project
nodes.info: A link specific to one student's own work belongs in that student's personal folder, where it survives independent of whatever the class folder changes to.
